feeds.description: Nashville Wifestyles is a Nashville Style Blog written by Ashley in which she talks about the latest trends, mom tips, and more. Ashley is a lover of anything beauty, fashion, or food. She plans on this being a lifestyle blog mainly because calling it a smorgasbord of all things I love just didn't sound as appealing or professional.

feeds.description: Hi! We're Kim & Kalee! We're are Nashville-based lifestyle influencers & mother-daughter. We share about our lives & our interests in personal development, traveling, entrepreneurship, & healthy living (mostly).

feeds.title: Nashville Wife
